column3: “appointed times” renders “mo’adim,” appointed feasts (also in verses 4, 37 and 44), and “holy convocations” renders “convocations of holiness.”
“a sabbath of complete rest” renders “a sabbath of sabbath observance (shabbaton).”
“laborious work” renders “work of servitude” (also in verses 8, 21, 25, 35 and 36).
NASB supplies “of an ephah” (also in verse 17).
“Until this same day” renders “until the bone (substance) of this day” (also in verses 21 and 28–30), and “new growth” renders “karmel,” fresh grain.
“to the very corners of your field” renders “you shall not finish the corner (pe’ah) of your field.”
“a rest” renders “shabbaton,” and “a reminder by blowing of trumpets” renders “a memorial of a loud blast (teru’ah)”; the Hebrew does not name trumpets.
“exactly” renders “surely (ak),” and “humble your souls” renders “afflict your souls” (also in verse 32).
